question.text: The number of different 5 digit numbers greater than 50000 that can be formed using the digits 0 , $1,2,3,4,5,6,7$, such that the sum of their first and last digits should not be more than 8 , is

solution.text:
$\begin{array}{lll}
\text { Case I } & 5 \ldots \ldots & 0 \\
\text { Case II } & 5 \ldots \ldots & \\
& 5 & 1 \\
& 5 & 3 \\
& 6 & 0 \\
& 6 & 1 \\
& 6 & 2 \\
& 7 & 0 \\
& 7 & 1
\end{array}$

$9 \times(8 \times 8 \times 8)=4608$ but 50000 is not included, so total numbers $4608-1=4607$
